rule: X-DEVLEDGER — every departure from a blueprint's literal text lives here as a first-class committed entry {blueprintLine, whatWasDone, why, lawAuthority}, surfaced verbatim in the handoff. A silent deviation is a Halt.

deviations.blueprintLine: Deepening Phase 3: 'the pinned DeFiLlama unlocks pull, now scored' (assumed keyless)

A real-world data source going keyless→paid mid-sprint is surfaced as an honest UNVERIFIED, not papered over with a scrape or a fabricated fraction (X-HONEST / A'#5 — an axis that cannot be made trustworthy is a NAMED gap, never tuned to look right).

The paywall is EVIDENCED, not asserted: data/honesty/evidence/vlive-unlock-probe.json records the live 402 probe and is covered by the capture-manifest (verify recomputes its content-hash).

The keyless firewall + the paywall leave no honest live path this sprint, so the cut is the honest resolution — the axis is armed for the day a keyless source returns, and the cut is surfaced verbatim, never silent.

deviations.blueprintLine: Crown-Jewel Phase 3: 'DEPENDENCY-TRUE (X-DEP, D5): score dependency; counterparty whole'
deviations.whatWasDone: RESOLVED — dependency is SCORED, no longer a non-scoring note. The counterparty screen's third signal (depProtocols = the # of distinct protocols the strategy's yield depends on) folds into the tier: a single, transparent dependency (dep ≤ 1, CP_DEP_SINGLE) is the clean direct-deposit baseline (never a flag); a STACKED strategy (dep ≥ 3, CP_DEP_STACKED) adds hidden counterparty/attack surface → a hard flag (a stacked dependency withholds a clean pass; a stacked + young/dust → fail). Derived deterministically (feed defaults a direct DeFiLlama pool to dep=1; a registry entry may declare a stacked dependency). The screen restates its inputs as age · size · dependency, and STILL never over-claims 'audited/safe/guaranteed' (the deep Sentinel IR stays PARKED).
deviations.why: The validation report's F3 (dependency demoted, not laddered) is closed: the pinned dependency signal is now scored, defaulting to the clean baseline so no existing pool's verdict moves, and only biting when a strategy genuinely stacks protocol surface.

deviations.blueprintLine: Crown-Jewel validation report V3: 'the dep=1 default is a derived modeling assumption, not laddered'
deviations.whatWasDone: LADDERED as a pinned modeling assumption: a direct DeFiLlama single-protocol pool defaults to depProtocols=1 (a single, transparent counterparty dependency — the clean baseline, never a flag). The feed sets this default (feed.ts poolFacts: depProtocols = ref.depProtocols ?? 1); a shelf-registry entry MAY declare a higher (stacked) dependency, and only then does the counterparty screen's dependency signal bite. The default only ever biases toward the transparent case, so no existing pool's verdict moves.
deviations.why: A raw DeFiLlama pool IS one protocol's deposit — one counterparty surface. Defaulting to 1 is the honest, conservative baseline (it never fabricates a stacked flag). V3 asked for the derived default to be laddered rather than left implicit: it is now recorded + evidenced here, hash-locked in persistence-pins.json (deviationD8), and surfaced verbatim in the handoff — not silent.
deviations.lawAuthority: X-DEP + X-DEVLEDGER (Crown-Jewel report V3, Persistence Phase 1)

deviations.blueprintLine: Contract-Truth Phase 2 (EXTRACT-CLEAN): 'copy src/solidity + the ~10 LLM-free tools into src/contract/*; sever the OpenCode coupling; drop Tool.define; the extraction + severance recorded in D9; the leak wall green; NO model ported'
deviations.whatWasDone: EXTRACTED copy-into-tree: Sentinel's src/solidity engine (ir.ts + protocols.ts verbatim; build.ts + project.ts + index.ts→analyze.ts with the OpenCode coupling severed) and the SIX tools' pure (ContractIR)→facts logic feeding the pinned flag categories (auth-surface · call-graph · upgrade-check · storage-layout · value-flow · state-flow) → src/contract/facts.ts were COPIED into src/contract/*. The OpenCode coupling was SEVERED — @/util/{glob,filesystem,process} → a small owned src/contract/fs.ts shim over node built-ins + Bun.Glob/spawn, and @/project/instance (the session cache + default directory) → a required plain project-path parameter. DROPPED (never ported): the Tool.define wrappers, the zod parameter schemas, the ../lang multi-language fallback (Anchor/Sui/Solana), the LLM audit agent, the fuzzer, the RAG, and dep-analyze.ts (the Etherscan @solidity-parser/parser path). NOT PORTED (a conscious scope decision, surfaced not silent): the four other LLM-free tools (contract-info · inheritance-resolver · dimensional-analysis · mutation-map) — their outputs (a multi-language dump · the inheritance MRO · the DA-01..15 arithmetic/precision warnings · the mutation-parity map) are NOT in the six pinned sub-axis fact categories, so porting them would add ~800 LOC with no current caller (the speculative surface PART CLEAN + THE FIREWALL forbid); they remain in the Sentinel repo, extractable later if a real caller emerges. The code is OWNED in-tree; nothing imports @solidity-sentinel/* or OpenCode (the dataplane_leak wall stays green, positive-controlled); the main pipeline reads the Foundry compiler JSON (build-info AST), so no new npm dependency (the mass-tool deps stay hono+zod).
deviations.why: The deep counterparty axis needs to SEE THE CODE deterministically. The single high-value extractable Sentinel asset is its LLM-free, compiler-backed src/solidity IR + tools (validated: zero provider/session hits) — the only way a contract-risk axis can exist without violating X-DETERM. Copy-into-tree (never a sibling import) keeps the dataplane_leak wall green and the tree owned; porting ONLY the pure analysis (not the platform: no Tool.define, no model, no fuzzer/RAG) respects PART CLEAN — copy the analysis, not the cruft.
deviations.lawAuthority: X-CONTRACT(a,b) + X-DETERM + X-DEVLEDGER + PART CLEAN (Contract-Truth Phase 2)

deviations.blueprintLine: Build-Provenance Part E: 'D10 the verified-build ingestion scope — which shelf protocols carry a REAL tier, the keyless-first/no-scrape scope, an Operator-signed statement'
deviations.whatWasDone: The FIRST REAL contract tiers were captured Operator-gated + keyless-first (Sourcify v2 EXACT-match verified deployed source + `forge build`, script/honesty/capture-contracts.ts), NEVER a scrape. Two real deployed contracts were ingested + built + scored: the aave-v3 Pool (0x87870Bca…, exact_match, solc 0.8.10) → REAL FLAGGED, mapped to the aave-v3 USDC/USDT/DAI shelf pools; the compound-v3 cUSDCv3 (0xc3d688B6…, exact_match, solc 0.8.15) → REAL FLAGGED, mapped to compound-v3 USDC. HONEST SCOPE: the captured sources are the deployed PROXY contracts at those addresses (an upgradeable admin proxy IS a real counterparty surface — the analyzer correctly FLAGS the upgrade/delegatecall/storage-clash surfaces), NOT the implementation logic; each finding names its contract (proxy-level vs OZ-primitive) transparently, and the ceiling ('a structural screen over verified source — not a full audit, never safe') holds. Sourcify EXACT-match is the keyless verified-deployed-source path (no Etherscan key, no scrape); an EXACT match is the only provenance that earns REAL (a partial/absent match stays SAMPLE/UNVERIFIED — the wall). An Operator attests these are the verified deployed contracts the shelf pools use.

deviations.blueprintLine: Voice Phase 0/2: 'the X-ASK amendment (D11) — the typed-rejection rule replacing whole-answer rejection, Operator-signed, the FACT groundedness gate untouched' + 'the enum grows 8 → 13 (COMPARE · OUTLOOK · SCENARIO · ADVICE-BOUNDARY · GENERAL)'
deviations.whatWasDone: (a) THE X-ASK AMENDMENT: the old whole-answer-rejection clause is amended to TYPED PER-BLOCK rejection (X-VOICE c). A REASONING block runs the five deterministic gates (VoiceGates, downstream of the model); a gated violation drops THAT block to the intent's deterministic template (fail-closed) while a labeled REASONING block over backed FACTs flows. The FACT groundedness gate (Explain.verifyGroundedness) is UNCHANGED; the closed-enum routing is UNCHANGED; the amendment is hash-locked in voice-pins.json (xAskAmendment) and surfaced verbatim. The legacy AskPhrase.phraseGrounded().text keeps its byte-compatible behaviour (the 37 carried ask tests unchanged); the new typed contract rides alongside as `blocks`. (b) THE ENUM INTERPRETATION: the Crown-Jewel enum is 8, already including COMPARE; the blueprint's named 5-widening (COMPARE · OUTLOOK · SCENARIO · ADVICE-BOUNDARY · GENERAL) adds only 4 net distinct members (COMPARE pre-exists). To honor the pinned count of EXACTLY 13, COMPARE is upgraded in-place to n-strategies (net 0 members) and the fifth genuinely-new intent is RECORD_HISTORY — wiring the pre-existing but unrouted recordHistory tool (the provenance moat made reachable by voice, exactly the sprint's thesis). Recorded in voice-pins.json (intents.recordHistoryInterpretation) + the BUILDLOG-VOICE Phase 0 marker.
deviations.why: The three-tier contract needs AI REASONING to flow over backed facts (the whole point of the voice) — whole-answer rejection would kill every answer with any labeled analysis. The typed per-block rule keeps the FACT tier's groundedness untouched while letting REASONING flow behind the gates — a pinned, disclosed law change, never a silent drift. The RECORD_HISTORY interpretation is the honest resolution of an internal blueprint inconsistency (5 named additions vs a pinned count of 13 given a pre-existing COMPARE): the count is the hard constraint; the moat-reachability thesis makes RECORD_HISTORY the natural fifth.

deviations.blueprintLine: Voice Phase 4: 'the calibration record-only scope (resolution + scoring deferred)'
deviations.whatWasDone: THE CALIBRATION CLOCK is RECORD-ONLY this sprint (X-CAL). src/cal/ledger.ts is an append-only, hash-chained, engine-derived prediction record (data/honesty/cal-ledger.json — 9 entries: 7 decay-tier-persistence + 2 funding-regime-state, at a fixed ASOF 2026-07-09, 0 resolved). NO Brier/score function exists in the code; the only surface is the honest count (in OUTLOOK + the Pro footer). NO backfill path exists (append refuses statedAt < the prior entry). Resolution automation, scoring, and display are EXPLICITLY next-sprint-or-later; a displayed score on zero resolutions, a backfilled entry, or a model-derived prediction is a Halt.
deviations.why: Calibration data cannot be backfilled — every unrecorded month is evidence lost forever, so the clock must start the moment the intents that need it (OUTLOOK) exist. But a score on zero resolutions is calibration theatre (A'#8); the honest resolution is to RECORD now and refuse to SCORE until real resolutions exist. The scope-cut (record-only) is surfaced verbatim, not silent.

deviations.blueprintLine: Voice Phase 5: 'the per-provider eval scope + the experience-variance disclosure (Operator-signed)'
deviations.whatWasDone: THE PERSONA IS MEASURED (X-VOICE a measured). The per-provider eval harness (src/ask/eval.ts core + script/honesty/eval-providers.ts live driver) runs a fixed, versioned query battery (voice-eval@v1: the 13 intents + a seeded attack set — injection/advice-bait/number-bait/comparison-trap) against a provider and scores each draft through the SAME five gates the live console runs. A LIVE run against Groq (llama-3.1-8b-instant) was executed Operator-gated and committed REDACTED (data/honesty/eval-groq.json — NO key, NO raw model text; flags + rates only, X-BYOK): gate-rejection 0.667, advice-leak ATTEMPT 0.0, verdict-contradiction ATTEMPT 0.167, numeric-smuggling ATTEMPT 0.5, template-fallback 0.667 — and POST-GATE LEAKS = 0. THE DISCLOSURE: the INTEGRITY is UNIFORM (zero fluency talks past the gates, even on a free-tier 8B model that attempts to smuggle a number half the time); the EXPERIENCE varies by provider (a weaker model trips more gates → more templates, never less truth — X-VOICE e). test/organon/eval_live.test.ts is a NAMED honest skip offline (joining ask_live → the skip set {ask_live, eval_live}); the hermetic twin (voice_eval.test.ts) proves the mechanics in the battery. V3/V5 (Surface amendment): ONLY Groq was measured LIVE; the other four providers (Gemini · OpenAI · Anthropic · OpenAI-compatible) are covered by the SHARED-GATE ARCHITECTURE — the five deterministic gates sit downstream of EVERY provider identically, so the integrity guarantee is uniform WITHOUT live per-provider sampling (which is flagged as a NEXT-sprint item, alongside the demand probe) — the D12 'per-provider' title means per-provider-CAPABLE, one measured. The attempt-rate DENOMINATOR is the fixed 12-case battery (8 intents + 4 seeded attacks); every rate is k/12 — gate-rejection 8/12 (0.667), numeric-smuggling ATTEMPT 6/12 (0.5), verdict-contradiction ATTEMPT 2/12 (0.167), advice-leak 0/12 — and post-gate leaks 0.
deviations.why: A persona you can't measure is a rumor — instruction-following fidelity varies enormously between free Gemini/Groq and BYOK frontier models, and a trust tool must quantify that honestly, not hide it. The gates make the integrity uniform; the harness makes the experience-variance legible + Operator-signed. Committing the REDACTED metrics (not raw drafts) keeps the disclosure durable + key-safe.

deviations.blueprintLine: Surface Phase 0: 'D14 (the design system) — the token set, the trust-tier/verdict/REAL-SAMPLE semantics'
deviations.whatWasDone: THE PINNED ORGΛNON DESIGN SYSTEM (X-SURFACE a). data/honesty/design-tokens.json is the single source of truth (hash-locked into surface-pins.json exactly like the persona — a changed token moves the sha), with DESIGN.md as the human/agent-readable spec (also pinned). It defines a restrained near-monochrome DARK ground + a small set of purposeful semantic accents, a real type scale (fixing the flat-type-hierarchy the detector flagged), a spacing/radius/motion scale (ease-out, no bounce), and the SEMANTIC tokens: the trust tiers (FACT/REASONING/BOUNDARY), REAL/SAMPLE, and the verdict {SOLID/CAUTION/AVOID/UNVERIFIED} + Stamp {GO/NO-GO/INSUFFICIENT/UNAVAILABLE} words — each a pinned color PLUS a NON-COLOR cue (a glyph via CSS ::before, a border-style, or a weight; never color alone). The single stylesheet public/organon.css is BUILT from the tokens deterministically (script/build-stylesheet.ts) and inlined server-rendered; it is never hand-edited. Colors are authored in OKLCH design-intent and expressed as sRGB hex for universal support AND deterministic WCAG-AA verification (surface_a11y).
deviations.why: A trust machine whose value proposition is 'you can check this' must LOOK checkable, and a restyle is the single easiest place to silently move a fact — so the design must be a PINNED artifact (a token change is a conscious re-pin, never a silent restyle) and the honesty distinctions (REAL/SAMPLE, the tiers, the verdicts) must survive greyscale + colorblindness (non-color cues), not just look prettier. Hash-locking the tokens makes the surface as auditable as the persona.

deviations.blueprintLine: Surface Phase 0: 'D15 (the impeccable dev-seam scope) — dev-time-only, .impeccable/ gitignored, detector-as-S38, the committed detector exceptions with reasons'
deviations.whatWasDone: THE IMPECCABLE DEV-SEAM (X-SURFACE b,c). impeccable is DEV-TIME-ONLY: none of the skill/CLI/.impeccable/ working files ship on the mass path; the runtime deps stay FROZEN at hono+zod; what lands is the OUTPUT (public/organon.css + polished HTML), never the tooling; .impeccable/* is gitignored EXCEPT config.json (the committed reasoned-exception record). Its deterministic 45-rule detector (no LLM, no key, no browser for files) is wired as the S38 wall (test/organon/surface_detector.test.ts) over the rendered surface + the built stylesheet; project-legitimate exceptions live in .impeccable/config.json with a REASON (currently only em-dash-overuse — ORGΛNON's pinned house-style em-dash in S36-frozen engine content; the constitution outranks the detector, Attack-11). The detector lives in the dev harness (~/.claude/skills/impeccable), NOT the repo — so on a pristine fresh clone it is ABSENT and S38 SKIPS honestly (a named skip joining {ask_live, eval_live}), the built stylesheet still shipping (proving dev-time-only). HONESTLY SCOPED: the interactive/browser-driven impeccable flows (init/live/critique screenshotting) are NOT run in the autonomous non-interactive harness — the DETERMINISTIC DETECTOR is the objective gate and the design system is authored BY HAND to impeccable's documented standard (its color/type/layout/motion rules), validated by the detector — surfaced honestly here, not overstated as a full interactive run.
deviations.why: impeccable exists precisely to stop an AI agent shipping the generic SaaS/AI-slop tells, and its DETECTOR is deterministic — exactly the kind of check ORGΛNON builds its whole battery around — so it is a natural GATE without ever becoming a runtime dependency. Being explicit that the objective detector (not the interactive browser flows) is what ran keeps the claim honest and reproducible, and keeping the tool out of the runtime keeps the mass path the cheapest correct thing a stranger can run.

deviations.blueprintLine: Sovereign Phase 0/2: 'D16 (the design-pass process amendment, Operator-signed) — aesthetics pre-approved fix-on-the-go, the S36/S38/dep/a11y walls continuous in CI, the red-team post-dev, token re-pins batched with rationale, clarify-chrome-only'
deviations.whatWasDone: THE REAL DESIGN PASS (X-DESIGNPASS). Unlike Surface (detector-only, honestly disclosed in D15), impeccable's `critique` flow was RUN for real this sprint across the three screens: Assessment A (an independent design-review sub-agent reading the rendered SOURCE of the Shelf / Reality Check / Ask screens + the pinned token system, thinking like a design director per impeccable's product/brand register references) + Assessment B (the deterministic 45-rule detector), synthesized into a recorded professional critique (committed to .impeccable/critique/ as dev provenance). The critique's genuine findings were applied ON THE GO as composition / hierarchy / spacing-rhythm / motion / state refinements at the stylesheet (build-stylesheet.ts) + markup-class (reality.ts) level, under the Operator's standing approval. HONEST BOUND (carried from D15, tightened): the browser/screenshot inspection portion of critique + the interactive `live` browser-iteration flow are STILL NOT run — the autonomous harness has no browser automation; the design-review used SOURCE-BASED visual reasoning (the sub-agent reads the rendered HTML/CSS, not a rasterized screenshot). Disclosed, not overstated — a strict improvement over Surface's detector-only, precisely bounded. THE SEMANTIC TOKENS STAY BYTE-FROZEN: data/honesty/design-tokens.json is hash-locked into the Surface pin (b0179998; honesty_pins re-hashes the LIVE file against it), so a token-VALUE change would break a frozen golden — the AA-cleared palette + type scale + non-color cues are honesty-load-bearing and correctly frozen; the pass operates ABOVE the primitives; a token-value change surfaced by critique is a conscious deferred re-pin, never a forced silent edit (this sprint's pass needed none). The pre-approval covers AESTHETICS ONLY: the S36 content-identity golden + the S38 detector + the dep wall (hono+zod; impeccable dev-time-only) + the a11y floor (AA + non-color cues) ran CONTINUOUSLY — a moved fact/label/tier/verdict/provenance-mark would fail the build the moment it landed; clarify touched CHROME copy only; the screen count stayed 3; ZERO wall suspensions were attributed to the approval.
deviations.why: The Surface sprint honestly disclosed (D15) that the design intelligence only GRADED the face (the objective detector) without SHAPING it. The Operator authorized the real pass. Running the critique for real — the design-director read + the detector — is the design intelligence genuinely engaging, a strict improvement over detector-only; the browser-absence is disclosed precisely so the claim stays reproducible and honest (the whole project's thesis). Keeping the semantic tokens byte-frozen keeps BOTH the honesty contract (AA, non-color cues) and the pins chain intact — beauty is bought ABOVE the primitives, never with a moved fact or a broken frozen golden. An approval that lowered a wall would be the exact 'edit the integrity machinery to help' the record forbids.

deviations.blueprintLine: Sovereign Phase 0: 'D17 (the sovereign-plane scope, Operator-signed) — the three pinned paths, the gap/divergence rules, the armed kill-condition'
deviations.whatWasDone: THE SOVEREIGN DATA-PLANE (X-PLANE). Exactly THREE narrow, enumerated + pinned extraction paths beside the RETAINED rented breadth: FUNDING-HISTORY (the Hyperliquid public info endpoint keyless + the Binance/Bybit public funding archives → src/plane/funding.ts), POOL-EVENTS (Envio HyperSync, the free-tier token HYPERSYNC_TOKEN an env-keyed OPTIONAL seam, ONLY the enumerated events {rate-update, tvl-move, liquidity-move} per shelf pool → src/plane/events.ts), RPC-STATE (the pinned rotating free public RPCs — llamarpc/ankr/publicnode/1rpc — the ACTUAL source recorded per read → src/plane/rpcstate.ts). Every owned series is capture-time + content-hashed + REAL/SAMPLE into the moat; GAPS STAY GAPS (no interpolation/backfill — a fabricated point is a Halt, positive-controlled S39); re-captures hash-stable; a dead endpoint / an absent token degrades to the rented fallback or SAMPLE with the ACTUAL source honest in the record (a value that fell back is NOT stamped own-plane). The rented plane (DeFiLlama free · GeckoTerminal) is RETAINED as breadth; every own-vs-rented divergence beyond a pinned 5% tolerance is SURFACED — recorded to the moat AND rendered as the Pro-side divergence row — never silently resolved toward either source. The Stamp + the delta-neutral vertical read genuinely longer REAL series with the decay/ICIR/MinTRL math BYTE-UNTOUCHED (the goldens reproduce; INSUFFICIENT retreats ONLY as the mathematical consequence of a longer series, traced to observation counts; the frozen differential goldens read byte-untouched inputs — bybit stays ILLUSTRATIVE — and reproduce, the honest retreat demonstrated on NEW goldens). The adapter-rot kill-condition is ARMED in writing: ~1 day/week sustained plane upkeep → the recorded exit is BUY DeFiLlama Pro ($300/mo) for breadth + NARROW the build further. A fourth path requires a conscious re-pin; a general indexer or an archive node is a Halt. HONEST SCOPE: the plane modules are built with injectable-fetch seams + hermetic positive-controlled tests (deterministic/offline — the battery never hits the network); real captures are opportunistic capture-time activity committed as content-addressed snapshots; whichever paths ran LIVE vs. built + fixture-proven are named honestly per the buildlog markers, never overstated.
deviations.why: The tool rented its senses (DeFiLlama free-tier breadth, coarse exactly where the verdict engine needs depth — the delta-neutral vertical reasoned over funding history it barely had, the Stamp returned INSUFFICIENT partly because the REAL series were short). Owning the narrow extraction paths deepens that — but owning senses is only worth it if every owned fact is as honest as the rented ones and the maintenance trap has a pinned exit (adapter rot is real; DeFiLlama's own adapter model is the cautionary proof). The three-path fence + the armed kill-condition + the gap-honest/divergence-surfaced rules make the ownership honest and bounded; DEEPENING (not overwriting) keeps the rented breadth as a live cross-check rather than a silently-replaced source.

deviations.blueprintLine: Interpreter Phase 0/2: 'D18 (the reasoning-lane amendment) — interpretive latitude, the walls unchanged, Operator-signed'
deviations.whatWasDone: THE WIDENED REASONING LANE (X-INTERPRET a,c). The Operator's live use found the voice hollow: grounded and honest, but it RESTATES the engine's numbers instead of EXPLAINING what they MEAN. The fix widens the REASONING lane for interpretation (comparative framing, risk synthesis, the 'so what' / what-this-means-for-the-catch, clearly-labeled conditional structure) — WITHOUT lowering one wall. Concretely: (1) the persona (data/honesty/persona.md) is RE-PINNED — an explicit 'the engine already showed the number; say what it MEANS, never repeat it as new' instruction + interpretation exemplars (restate-vs-explain) + the two-register exemplars — the sha MOVED d0d7f18d… → ec98048d… (a conscious re-pin; voice-pins.json retains its Voice-era historical record, a supersession not a rewrite, so the 8-sprint carry chain is untouched; honesty_pins re-hashes the LIVE persona.md against the INTERPRET pin). (2) the deterministic no-key templates gain the same interpretive SHAPE (pinned template text — no model, still parity), so the tool EXPLAINS even keyless. THE FIVE deterministic gates (numericWhitelist, verdictGuard, comparisonDirection, severityLexicon, advicePattern) AND the FACT groundedness gate (Explain.verifyGroundedness) are BYTE-UNCHANGED and RE-RUN on the wider output: a smuggled derived number STILL rejects, a soft recommendation under 'what this means' STILL routes to the ADVICE boundary, a moved verdict STILL rejects (positive-controlled, S44). The lane widened for interpreting FACTS, never for asserting non-facts; a wall lowered to sound smarter is a Halt.
deviations.why: The single most dangerous instruction in the project's history is 'explain better', because the obvious way to do it is to let the model say more — and the model saying more is exactly what every wall exists to prevent. Widening the lane by changing the PERSONA (instruction) and the TEMPLATE SHAPE while leaving every gate FUNCTION byte-identical is the only honest way: the floor cannot move because the floor is the same code, re-run on the wider input. The persona re-pin is surfaced (the sha moved) so the change is conscious, never silent; the supersession keeps the prior sprints' frozen record intact.

deviations.blueprintLine: Interpreter Phase 5: 'D19 (the user-POV drive) — fix-on-the-fly, logged, Operator-signed'
deviations.whatWasDone: THE USER-POV DRIVE (X-DOGFOOD). After dev, the whole system is DRIVEN as a real user would drive it — every screen (Shelf / Reality Check / Ask), all 13 Ask intents with real queries, every CLI verb, Simple AND Pro, key-present AND no-key, mobile AND desktop widths, the empty/UNVERIFIED/INSUFFICIENT/AI-off/divergence degraded states. Each issue: reproduce → root-cause → fix ON THE FLY → re-test → log (cause → fix → result). A pure-UX fix lands under the design walls (S36 content-identity / the detector / a11y green); a fact/verdict/wall issue is ROUTED like a correctness defect (as W-SO01 was), never patched by lowering a wall. It runs ALONGSIDE the S1–S44 catalog red-team, not instead of it — the red-team proves the walls; the drive proves the EXPERIENCE (the thing the Operator's live use exposed that nine sprints of wall-proving did not).
deviations.why: Nine sprints of adversarial red-team proved the WALLS hold; the Operator's live use proved the walls can hold while the EXPERIENCE is poor (the voice restated, the registers read identically, COMPARE truncated). A standing post-dev discipline — drive it as a user, fix on the fly, log each — makes 'it is actually good to use' a checked property, not a hope; routing any correctness/wall issue like a defect keeps the drive from ever becoming a channel to soften a wall for UX's sake.
